args.description: dazed and dizzy after his guard breaks: stands slumped on wobbly bent knees, both arms hanging limp at his sides, head drooping and rolling slowly in a circle, eyes half closed, the whole body swaying from side to side on the spot, a seamless loop that ends exactly on the first pose. Only the character is drawn. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no effect, no motion streak, no speed lines, no trail behind the limbs or the weapon, no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture. Every frame shows the arms, legs and weapon clearly in a crisp pose, never blurred.
args.subject_description: a young man with spiky black hair streaked with red, red eyes, a long red scarf, an open black and red coat over a bare chest, black trousers, red and black boots
args.initial_pose: fighting stance facing right, fists raised
